title: Look picker demo
stand_in: These frames are generated placeholders, only to show the format. In real use, each “Planned edit” frame is a still image of the planned visual. The buttons work: your clicks are saved.

moments.caption: From the first word: a title card behind you, zoom 1.0x → 1.28x

what: Typed title behind your head: “salt your / pasta water” (you cut out in front)
Hook zoom from 1.0x to 1.28x during the line
beats.music: The sample track starts on the first frame, under the voice

ref.why: Title behind the head, as in the reference

alerts: No sound effect: the title is typed with no keyboard sound

beats.line: Taste as you go. Every sauce, every soup, every stew.

moments.caption: On “Taste”: a soft glow lights the frame
On “stew”: a burst of light and a 4% push

what: A light band passes on “Every”, on the music beat
A light burst on “stew”, with a 4% push
beats.music: Keeps going; the light band lands on the beat
beats.ref_none: No reference: this look was picked from the options
